purpose: development pilot: legal feedback-driven revision and bounded work-domain mapping
cache_policy: Mapping has its own cache; two cold controls each have an empty cache. Each Pi owner has an isolated cache. Report logical invocations and actual wall/archives separately; no speedup claim.
intervention_policy: No operator-chosen next candidate during a Pi trajectory; any runtime repair or prompt continuation is recorded as intervention. No held-out method comparison in this pilot.
p3_trigger: Use mapping and real Pi failures to select one physical architecture freedom only after this pilot; no automatic broadening.
p4_trigger: Useful/ineffective/boundary candidates and at least one complete feedback trajectory; physical ranking gates remain explicit.
